profile.visual_desc: Muscular human in a long brown cloak and blue trousers. Features spiky navy blue hair and a white forehead visor. Rear-isometric view emphasizes the heavy fabric of the cape.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stoic left-facing profile. Features spiky dark blue hair and a thick white headband covering the brow. Expression is calm and determined.
profile.weapon_desc: One-handed straight sword held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Frame 1: Low crouch from a rear-isometric view facing up-left. Sword held back at hip level, pointed toward the target.
profile.step2_windup: Frames 2-3: Transitions to a two-handed grip, raising the sword high above the head in a vertical overhead wind-up.
profile.step3_impact: Frame 4: Power lunge forward. A large, fan-shaped golden energy flash erupts from the blade, angled toward the top-left.
profile.step4_finish: Frames 5-6: Follow-through into a deep crouch. The sword is held low as the golden sparks and light trail dissipate.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The triangular golden flash in Frame 4 aligns perfectly with the downward overhead trajectory of the sword swing.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation preserves perspective and biomechanics. Overhead swing and VFX timing match reference.
